finding.message: This link has no ScreenTip. Screen readers need a description of each link in the PDF, and Word adds it to the PDF only from the ScreenTip.
finding.how_to_fix: Right-click the link, choose Edit Hyperlink, choose ScreenTip, and type a short description of where the link goes. The tool can copy the link text into the ScreenTip for you.

location.place: paragraph 3 (no text), after the heading "Test guide"
location.heading: Test guide

description: Copy the link text into the ScreenTip of this link (the description that Word writes into the PDF).

availability.reason: The link has no text to copy into a ScreenTip, and the tool does not make one up. In Word, right-click the link, choose Edit Hyperlink, choose ScreenTip, and type a short description of where the link goes.
